rationale.cpu: Worker executes a 420 ms cycle once every 300 seconds (~0.14% duty cycle). 0.5 vCPU limit prevents burst spikes from impacting neighbor web apps while granting 3.5x headroom for the hot path.
rationale.memory: Base Python runtime with NumPy/Pandas and engine consumes ~118 MB RSS. Setting limit to 384 MB provides more than 3x headroom while guaranteeing zero risk of OOM on the VPS.
